vars.client-tools: clusterdb createdb createuser dropdb dropuser pg_amcheck pg_basebackup pg_dump pg_dumpall pg_isready pg_receivewal pg_recvlogical pg_restore pg_verifybackup psql reindexdb vacuumdb

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/postgres/postgres.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" 724edf9bde9d356724ad384a2e196edc3c9f80f7; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 724edf9bde9d356724ad384a2e196edc3c9f80f7
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach 724edf9bde9d356724ad384a2e196edc3c9f80f7
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "724edf9bde9d356724ad384a2e196edc3c9f80f7: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

# Symlink postgres to /usr/bin
mkdir -p ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/bin
ln -sf /usr/libexec/${{vars.mangled-package-name}}/postgres ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/bin/postgres${{vars.major-version}}

# the official postgres image listens on all interfaces by default, let's do the same for consistency
sed -ri "s!^#?(listen_addresses)\s*=\s*\S+.*!\1 = '*'!" ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/share/${{vars.mangled-package-name}}/postgresql.conf.sample
grep -F "listen_addresses = '*'" ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/share/${{vars.mangled-package-name}}/postgresql.conf.sample

mkdir -p ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/bin
for binary in ${{vars.client-tools}}; do
  ln -sf /usr/libexec/${{vars.mangled-package-name}}/${binary} ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/bin/${binary}
done

pipeline.name: Unversioned PostgreSQL client identity
pipeline.runs:
test "$(apk list --installed postgresql-client 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')" = "postgresql-client-${{package.full-version}}"
psql --version | grep -F "${{package.version}}"

mkdir -p ${{targets.subpkgdir}}
make DESTDIR=${{targets.subpkgdir}} -C contrib install
# The PL/Perl transform modules (bool/hstore/jsonb_plperl) ship in the
# -plperl subpackage, matching Debian's postgresql-plperl layout. Drop
# them here so -contrib carries no libperl runtime dependency.
find "${{targets.subpkgdir}}" -name '*plperl*' -delete

mkdir -p ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib
mv ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/lib/libpq.so* ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/

mkdir -p ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib
mv ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/lib/libecpg.so* ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/
mv ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/lib/libecpg_compat.so* ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/
mv ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/lib/libpgtypes.so* ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/

mkdir -p ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/include/postgresql
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/include/ecpg*.h ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/include/postgresql/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/include/postgresql/informix ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/include/postgresql/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/include/pgtypes*.h ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/include/postgresql/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/include/sql3types.h ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/include/postgresql/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/include/sqlca.h ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/include/postgresql/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/include/sqlda*.h ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/include/postgresql/

mkdir -p ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/pkgconfig
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/lib/libecpg.* ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/lib/libpgtypes.* ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/lib/pkgconfig/libecpg.pc ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/pkgconfig/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/lib/pkgconfig/libecpg_compat.pc ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/pkgconfig/
mv ${{targets.outdir}}/${{package.name}}-dev/usr/lib/pkgconfig/libpgtypes.pc ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/lib/pkgconfig/

# Test that key header files are present
test -f /usr/include/postgresql/ecpg_config.h
test -f /usr/include/postgresql/ecpglib.h
test -f /usr/include/postgresql/pgtypes.h
test -f /usr/include/postgresql/sqlca.h

# Test that pkgconfig files are present and working
pkg-config --exists libecpg
pkg-config --exists libecpg_compat
pkg-config --exists libpgtypes

# Test that static libraries are present
test -f /usr/lib/libecpg.a
test -f /usr/lib/libpgtypes.a

subpackages.name: ecpg
subpackages.description: Embedded PostgreSQL SQL preprocessor for C programs

pipeline.runs:
mkdir -p ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/bin/
mv ${{targets.destdir}}/usr/libexec/${{vars.mangled-package-name}}/ecpg ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/usr/bin/
ecpg --help

mkdir -p "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"

# Move contents of main package to base package
mv "${{targets.destdir}}"/* "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"

# Create symlinks to binaries in execdir to bindir in main package
export bindir="${{targets.destdir}}/usr/bin"
export execdir="/usr/libexec/${{vars.mangled-package-name}}"

mkdir -p "${bindir}"

cd "${{targets.subpkgdir}}/${execdir}"
for binary in *; do
  ln -sf "${execdir}/${binary}" "${bindir}/${binary}"
done

pipeline.name: Test database creation
pipeline.runs:
useradd $PGUSER
sudo -u $PGUSER initdb -D /tmp/test_db
sudo -u $PGUSER pg_ctl -D /tmp/test_db -l /tmp/logfile start
createdb testdb
psql -lqt | cut -d \| -f 1 | grep -Fw testdb

pipeline.name: Test basic read/write operations
pipeline.runs:
psql -d testdb -c "CREATE TABLE test_table (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, test_value VARCHAR(50));"
psql -d testdb -c "INSERT INTO test_table (test_value) VALUES ('Hello, PostgreSQL!');"
psql -d testdb -t -A -c "SELECT test_value FROM test_table WHERE id=1;"

pipeline.name: Test xml support
pipeline.runs:
psql -d testdb -c "CREATE TABLE test (data xml);"
psql -d testdb -c "INSERT INTO test values (XMLPARSE(CONTENT '<foo>bar</foo>'));"

pipeline.name: Test server can run and respond to requests
pipeline.runs: psql -d testdb -c "\conninfo"

pipeline.name: Test XML xpath support
pipeline.runs: psql -d testdb -c "SELECT xpath('/book/title', '<book><title>My Title</title></book>');" | grep "<title>My Title</title>"

pipeline.name: Test ICU collation presence
pipeline.runs: psql -d testdb -c "SELECT collname FROM pg_collation WHERE collprovider = 'i';" | grep -E "unicode|und-x-icu|af-x-icu"

pipeline.name: Test JIT is enabled
pipeline.runs: psql -t -A -d testdb -c "SHOW jit;" | grep "on"

pipeline.name: Test toast compression set to lz4
pipeline.runs: psql -t -A -d testdb -c "SET default_toast_compression = 'lz4'; SHOW default_toast_compression;" | grep "^lz4$"

pipeline.name: Peer, SCRAM, TLS, JIT, extensions and backup/restore consumers
pipeline.runs:
cat > /tmp/postgresql-consumers.sh <<'WEREWOLF_POSTGRESQL_CONSUMERS'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    id pgtest >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -M -s /bin/sh pgtest
    exec su -p -s /bin/sh pgtest -c "exec sh '$0'"
fi
bindir=$(pg_config --bindir)
export PATH=$bindir:$PATH
# Verify both sides of authentication: libpq must not retain GSSAPI/LDAP either.
for binary in "$bindir/postgres" /usr/lib/libpq.so.5; do
    if ldd "$binary" | grep -E 'lib(pam|ldap|gssapi|krb5)'; then
        echo "optional authentication library remains: $binary" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done
pg_config --configure | grep -- '--with-llvm'
work=$(mktemp -d)
export HOME=$work
trap 'pg_ctl -D "$work/data" -m immediate stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
export PGHOST=$work PGUSER=pgtest PGDATABASE=postgres PGPORT=55432
initdb -D "$work/data" --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 --auth-local=peer --auth-host=scram-sha-256
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout "$work/server.key" -out "$work/server.crt" -days 1 -subj /CN=localhost -addext subjectAltName=DNS:localhost
chmod 600 "$work/server.key"
cat >> "$work/data/postgresql.conf" <<EOF
unix_socket_directories = '$work'
port = 55432
listen_addresses = '127.0.0.1'
ssl = on
ssl_cert_file = '$work/server.crt'
ssl_key_file = '$work/server.key'
EOF
pg_ctl -D "$work/data" -l "$work/server.log" -w start
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
ALTER ROLE pgtest PASSWORD 'consumer-test-password';
CREATE EXTENSION pg_trgm;
CREATE EXTENSION pgcrypto;
CREATE EXTENSION "uuid-ossp";
CREATE TABLE documents(id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), body jsonb NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO documents(body) VALUES ('{"title":"common consumer","count":3}');
CREATE INDEX documents_search ON documents USING gin ((body->>'title') gin_trgm_ops);
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM documents WHERE body->>'title' ILIKE '%consumer%') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'JSONB/search query failed';
  END IF;
END $$;
SQL
export PGPASSWORD=consumer-test-password
# TLS hostname verification plus password authentication, as application drivers use.
export PGHOST=localhost PGHOSTADDR=127.0.0.1 PGSSLMODE=verify-full PGSSLROOTCERT=$work/server.crt
[ "$(psql -At -c "SELECT body->>'count' FROM documents")" = 3 ]
psql -At -c 'SET jit_above_cost=0; EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT sum(i) FROM generate_series(1,10000) AS i' > "$work/jit.json"
grep '"JIT"' "$work/jit.json"
pg_dump --format=custom --file="$work/backup" postgres
createdb restored
pg_restore --exit-on-error --dbname=restored "$work/backup"
[ "$(psql -d restored -At -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM documents')" = 1 ]
echo 'PASS: peer/SCRAM/TLS, JSONB, common extensions, LLVM JIT and backup/restore'
WEREWOLF_POSTGRESQL_CONSUMERS
sh /tmp/postgresql-consumers.sh
